architecture: language-independent PrintC emitBlockIf PendingBrace emission on a hand-built production-shape 3-component BlockIf (BlockBasic originals, BlockCopy mirrors via newBlockCopy/copymap/replaceUsingMap as buildCopy block.cc:1925-1938, nested child BlockIf via identifyInternal+addBlock like ruleBlockProperIf bottom-up, parent via identifyInternal over [cond copy, then copy, child BlockIf]); no Funcdata, no Architecture
compiler_spec: none: the CBRANCH conditions and RETURN values are Constant-space varnodes with int Datatypes attached via new HighVariable (Rugra: v_type-free const path), so both sides render them through their constant paths

analysis_options.entrypoint: PrintC::emitBlockIf driven directly per case (Rugra: PrintC::emit_block_graph on a graph whose sole top-level block is the parent BlockIf, dispatching to emit_structured_if); both sides wrap emission in beginFunction/endFunction (printc.cc:2651/2664 docFunction group context, required by EmitPrettyPrint's indent stack); no Action pipeline runs
analysis_options.prestate: shared shape: parent properif(cond BlockBasic ending CBRANCH const 3, then BlockBasic 2-input RETURN const 20, else = child properif); child condition varies: [RETURN 21, CBRANCH 9] (cases 1,3) or [CBRANCH 9] alone (case 2); child then = RETURN 40; child has no else; emitter varies: EmitPrettyPrint (cases 1-2, production per printlanguage.cc:69) or EmitNoMarkup (case 3)
analysis_options.observation: two layers per case: (statement) the full byte stream with newlines preserved; (raw) hex of the same stream. No normalization — both layers are byte-identical between the oracle and Rugra

input_manifest.canonicalization: sha256 over the canonical input description above
cases: elseif_stmtcond_pretty: child condition statement's tagLine FIRES the installed PendingBrace (emitPending prettyprint.cc:920 -> openBraceIndent same_line printc.cc:2872-2876) -> `else {` + `return 0x15;` + newline `if (9) {` + deferred closeBraceIndent (printc.cc:2946-2948); the main-region golden shape
elseif_emptycond_pretty: nothing fires the brace -> printc.cc:2900-2902 cancelPendingPrint + spaces(1) -> merged `else if (9) {`, no deferred close

elseif_stmtcond_nomarkup: EmitNoMarkup::tagLine (prettyprint.hh:557) never calls emitPending -> slot stays installed through the condition statements -> cc:2900-2902 merges after inline statements, indentId stays -1 so cc:2946 closes nothing; locks the base-class-slot-without-fire semantics

observation_schema.format: per case: '<name>=' followed by the byte stream (statement mode, newlines preserved) or its hex (--raw mode)
observation_schema.normalization: none — statement and raw layers are compared byte-for-byte; both MATCH

observation.evidence: oracle binary built from the locked tree (libdecomp.a at e40ed130) and Rugra rlib (src at the printc_pending_brace_emit_1204 fixture commit, incl. the while-break-fold regression test) produce identical statement and raw streams for all three cases (2026-08-30, w-printc2)
